name: English - English for Political Science C1
description:
This course prepares students to read and understand political science texts in English. The texts have been chosen by various professors at the HfP, covering the fields of political theory, comparative politics, and international relations. We will especially focus on interpreting these texts in light of current affairs. 

Class time will be largely dedicated to discussions, presentations, and text analysis. The course emphasizes expanding vocabulary, spoken fluency, and persuasive writing and argumentation skills.

Graded tasks include an oral presentation (20%), multiple drafts of an essay (1000-1200 words, 40%), online forum posts (10%), and a final written examination (30%).

Frequently Asked Questions:
  -  "Is this course an easy way to get 3 ECTS points with no work?" - No.
  -  "Will I improve my English a ton and enjoy myself in the process?" - Yes.
prerequisites: Ability to work at the C1 level, as demonstrated through the placement test in Moodle
